cacheEligibleRecords.description: Selected gateway_request invocations after revision deduplication and window/scope/origin filtering, regardless of phase or outcome. Non-Gateway spans are excluded.

cacheObservedRecords.description: cacheHits + cacheMisses; denominator of cacheHitRate. Only explicit boolean cacheHit evidence without a cacheHit missingFields marker is observed.

cacheUnknownRecords.description: Eligible Gateway records with absent, null, non-boolean or explicitly marked missing cacheHit evidence. Never counted as misses. Normalizers must preserve unknown evidence; historical false values synthesized from missing fields cannot be distinguished here.

cacheHits.description: Eligible Gateway records with observed cacheHit strictly true.

cacheMisses.description: Eligible Gateway records with observed cacheHit strictly false. Does not imply caching was enabled or an upstream request occurred.

cacheHitRate.description: cacheHits / cacheObservedRecords, a fraction from 0 to 1; null when the denominator is zero, including empty buckets and non-Gateway scopes. Unknown records are excluded.

cacheCoveragePartial.description: True when cacheUnknownRecords > 0. Coverage applies only to selected retained Gateway records; false does not establish complete collection/history or cache applicability.

registeredServers.description: Number of authorized server assets matching the asset and serverType filters.

serversWithBusinessObservations.description: Registered servers with matching asset ID and serverType in the selected retained business facts.

serversWithReportedState.description: Registered servers with a persisted asset-scope report; reports need not be recent or valid heartbeats.

unrepresentedBusinessServers.description: Distinct observed (asset ID, serverType) pairs absent from the matching authorized server directory, including type mismatches. No resource identifiers are exposed.

unattributedBusinessInvocations.description: Selected business invocations without an asset ID. Visible only when permitted by the invocation query scope.

historyCompleteSince.description: Unknown: retained invocation facts cannot establish complete historical collection.

gaps.description: Evidence gaps within the authorized selection. No hidden asset counts or global pipeline state.

count.description: Retained started, unfinished business facts at snapshotSeq across all start times. Not verified live requests; zero never establishes no traffic.

dataWatermark.description: Null: managed lifecycle evidence does not share the invocation sequence.

businessProcessLivenessEvaluated.description: A durable host event observation, not a continuous business-process heartbeat.

generation.description: Opaque identity for one managed child-process generation.

lifecycleStatus.description: Last persisted report, not a current process-liveness assertion.

healthStatus.description: Historical reported health; no freshness or heartbeat guarantee.

managedProcessLifecycle.description: Last durable managed-child event for this asset; absence or started does not prove current liveness.

gatewayRoutingObservation.description: This observer process registry only; not listener, dependency or whole-cluster health.

lifecycleStatus.description: Persisted runtime_assets status, not a process heartbeat.

lastHeartbeatAt.description: Unknown: legacy state updates are not heartbeats.

activeInvocations.description: Unknown until producer liveness is verified.

unknownInFlight.description: Unfinished business invocations observed within the selected start window; not all active requests.

observedBusinessRequests.description: Observed business invocations in the selected window; zero does not prove no traffic.

businessObservationStatus.description: Selected retained business evidence only; not_observed does not mean idle or offline.

lastSuccessAt.description: Latest observed business success completion among selected starts.

lastFailureAt.description: Latest observed error/timeout/incomplete completion among selected business starts.

stateVersion.description: Unknown: legacy state has no version tied to the call-event sequence.

serverStateSnapshot.description: Process-local server_state_v1 read grant for durable lifecycle and retained in-flight evidence only; excludes directory, legacy state and heartbeat. Not a completeness or global liveness claim.

managementHeartbeat.description: Global-scope only; management process store roundtrip evidence, never Gateway/MCP liveness.

dataWatermark.description: Null: current asset and legacy state updates do not advance the invocation sequence.

restricted.description: True for asset-scoped grants; never reports hidden asset counts.

invocationSnapshotSeq.description: Invocation facts only. May be used as events afterSequence only with an issued unexpired grant and matching origin/serverType/runtimeAssetId plus unchanged principal/asset permissions. Does not initialize legacy server state.

invocationSnapshotAuthorized.description: Whether this process registered the invocation snapshot for events afterSequence. False when the authorizer is not integrated.

invocationSnapshotExpiresAt.description: Process-local grant expires after five minutes; at most 1000 grants, oldest issuance evicted first. Restart or eviction requires a new overview even before this expiry. No global state/event coverage guarantee.

businessSummary.description: Observed retained records, not an assertion of complete traffic capture.

upstreamSummary.description: Zero observed upstream requests does not imply zero upstream traffic; coverage remains partial/unknown.

unavailableSections.description: Sections not implemented by this subset; omitted instead of fabricated empty data.

restricted.description: Asset-scoped grants are applied before every query; no hidden-resource counts are exposed.

failures.description: Observed error, timeout or incomplete upstream invocations.

affectedBusinessRequests.description: Distinct nearest visible external business invocations reached through parent links from failed upstream attempts, within the same asset, trace and selected start window. Each MCP Tool counts separately even under one protocol root. Affected does not imply the business invocation ultimately failed.

unlinkedFailureRecords.description: Failed external upstream records without a verifiable visible business ancestor. Does not disclose hidden root IDs or counts.

relationshipsComplete.description: True only when every selected failed external upstream record has a visible business ancestor; not a historical completeness guarantee.

dependencyBasis.description: Only observed upstream dependencies, not configured but unused bindings; parent links require retained visible evidence in this window.

scanCoverage.description: Single scan coverage only; never an atomic whole-disk snapshot.

observedBytes.description: Logical lengths measured in this scan batch before any cleanup; excludes filesystem allocation overhead.

currentTotalBytes.description: Unknown; scan samples are never a current filesystem total.

hasMore.description: The metadata page filled its limit; more eligible rows may remain.

metadataReconciliation.description: Metadata-only repair in this retained report; independent of filesystem scan counters.

workerConfigured.description: Last reported configuration, not current process enablement.

lastReportAt.description: Time of the retained complete report; may precede a more recent failed attempt.

currentAttemptComplete.description: False means the latest attempt did not complete; partial deletions cannot be inferred from the previous report.

staleAfterMs.description: Recent evidence is not proof that the worker is alive.

pendingBuckets.description: Metric bucket JSON recompute.state=pending count, matching Store selection.

pendingCallerBuckets.description: Caller bucket JSON recompute.state=pending count, matching Store selection.

lastRunRecomputedBuckets.description: Most recent collector run report, not a cumulative count or heartbeat.

lastRunRecomputeFailures.description: Most recent collector run recompute failures; not failed invocation records.

countsObservedAt.description: Snapshot read time, not a worker heartbeat.

state.description: Persisted report from the most recent worker run, not current health.

snapshotSeq.description: Last worker run snapshot, not a delivery acknowledgement watermark.

workerConfigured.description: Last persisted configuration report, not current enablement.

lastAttemptAt.description: Worker-reported lastAttemptAt; may be set even when claimed=0.

observationAgeMs.description: Age of the persisted outbox observation, not delivery lag.

bucketVersion.description: Null for synthetic buckets; persisted buckets expose versioned content.

maxQueryRange.description: Milliseconds; concrete endpoints can reject time-window parameters entirely.

eventRetention.description: Effective retention for newly created unified events, not a guarantee of historical coverage; null without visible assets.

invocationCount.description: Invocation boundaries, not people, connections, or deduplicated business requests.

profileSnapshot.description: Editable profile is current; observation ordering and summary use the call snapshot.

firstSeenAt.description: First start within the authorized selected invocation set.

lastSeenAt.description: Latest completion or start within the authorized selected invocation set.

profileSnapshot.description: Editable profile is current; observation ordering and summary use the call snapshot.

profileEtag.description: Strong ETag supplied only when management covers all registered caller assets.

credentialIds.description: Credential IDs observed in this authorized window, never credential secrets.

readLink.description: Controlled relative endpoint; every read checks permission and retention.

publicationSnapshot.description: Not collected yet; reported in missingFields.

invocationId.description: Visible child; never the unavailable parent ID.

relationshipsComplete.description: Declared references of returned nodes are present and acyclic; not proof of complete history.
